title: Mayfair Ottoman Divan Bed – Gas Lift Storage Bed
descriptionHtml:
Need storage and a headboard in one purchase? The Mayfair Ottoman Divan Bed combines the Mayfair upholstered headboard with an end-opening hydraulic gas lift ottoman base, so the whole space under the mattress becomes storage. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £337.99 in Single 3ft to £519.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Mayfair upholstered headboard
  • End-opening hydraulic gas lift ottoman base
  • Large underbed storage compartment
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

  • Single (3FT): £337.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £415.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £441.99
  • King (5FT): £467.99
  • Super King (6FT): £519.99

Not sure which size you need? See our UK bed sizes guide.

Storage

The base lifts on hydraulic gas struts at the foot end, opening the storage underneath while the mattress stays in place. Leave clear floor at the foot of the bed and check there is nothing fixed above that would stop the platform opening. See how ottoman beds work.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and fully upholstered by hand. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, with custom fabric and colour options available on request.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

Compare the Bumper Ottoman Storage Bed or browse divan ottoman beds. Not sure of the difference? Read ottoman bed vs divan bed.

FAQ

How does the gas lift storage work?

Hydraulic gas struts raise the mattress platform from the foot end, opening the storage underneath.

Is the headboard included?

Yes, the Mayfair upholstered headboard is part of the design.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check colour and texture at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
